text: Pope Pius X placed Louis Duchesne's Histoire ancienne de l'Eglise on the Index in January 1912, judging it too modernist. Duchesne submitted to the decision and remained a priest in good standing.
meta_description: Histoire ancienne de l'Eglise by Louis Duchesne was placed on the Index by Pope Pius X in January 1912 as too modernist.
changes: Author named in first sentence; decision and response kept.
